utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Noah, are you free Saturday morning? Sam's organizing a repair drive at his garage, and we could use extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Saturday? I thought I heard it was tomorrow... or was that something else? I'll have to check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No, it's definitely Saturday morning, Noah. Sam's been planning it for a while—I'm rallying my book club crew to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll pencil you in for Saturday morning — we can meet by the school gate around 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 9 by the school gate — got it. Do I need to bring anything specific, like tools or something?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just bring yourself and maybe a pair of gloves if you have them — I'll have the rest sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Gus, I've got the repair drive scheduled for Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Do you have the tools list ready?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure do, Opal. I've got the list right here—hammers, screwdrivers, and my trusty power drill ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Gus. I'm making a note to check that the tool inventory matches your list by Friday evening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried people won't sign up ahead of time, and we'll have a real mess on our hands with the queue.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's a good point, Pia. Maybe we can put up a big sign-up sheet at the community board and send a reminder flyer to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that's a smart idea—I just hope folks actually read the flyer and don't all show up at once anyway.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community garden shed—want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, I've been spreading the word! The repair drive's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center—I'm handling fence repairs, and we've got Sam helping with heavy lifting and Tess bringing tools. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds like you've got it covered, Vik! I'll spread the word to a few more folks—let's make this a big turnout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, is it this Saturday? I thought it was next month... Better check my calendar, if I can find it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Oren, you and your calendar! It's definitely this Saturday—Vik and I have been rounding up things all week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday it is then! I'll try to remember my toaster... or at least remember to show up. Maybe you can remind me with a pie?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's next Saturday at the community center. They're taking old power tools and spare parts. If you've got anything, you should swing by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I heard about that! I'm actually helping out with the heavy lifting and tool work—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, glad you're on board. I'll be there at 9 to drop off some stuff, so maybe we can team up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there at 8 sharp, just to help get everything sorted before the crowd arrives.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, early birds like us can make sure nothing gets overlooked.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's right, Mara. I'll bring my toolbox and we can double-check Opal's list before the others show up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, a repair drive? I think I saw something about that in the community board notes. Are we talking about the one for the community center's old computer system?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, that's the one. It's this Saturday, and I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll be there too. Do we need to bring any tools or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You've used it before, huh? Well, I guess I'll trust you on this one... for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, it's probably fine. I'll check later if something's missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, check later? Shouldn't we be a bit more careful if there's even a chance something's wrong?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good to see you both. I'm looking forward to helping out on Saturday—just let me know what needs sorting first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, I just got here myself—did I miss the sorting list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, Dane. Faye mentioned she'd show us everything Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'll put you down then! And if you know anyone else who'd like to join, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's wonderful, Rosa—I'll be sure to mention it to my other neighbor, Sarah, she's always got a project or two going.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, the more hands the better! I’ll make sure we have enough coffee and snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've already mapped out three priority spots on Main Street. I'll share the list Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I'll bring a few folks from my book club to Sam's garage—we'll be ready to pitch in wherever you need us.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll add Sam's garage to my map. That'll be a solid fourth stop on the route.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, so it IS tomorrow? I need to get my tools ready then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it’s tomorrow—I just double-checked before heading over. Better grab your gear tonight!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Dane. I'll set an alarm so I don't forget—my brain's been like a sieve lately.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Pia, just ran into Leo—he's got the tools ready for the repair drive tomorrow at 9. You planning to come by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, yes, I'll be there, but I hope everyone signed up in advance—Faye's helping me schedule around the school runs, so it should flow.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that's good to know. I can grab any spare parts folks drop off while you handle the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Quinn, I'm glad the repair drive's coming together. Need any extra tools or supplies from my garage?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam! Some extra screwdrivers and a level would be great if you have them. Want to come join us at 9 AM? We'd love to have you!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll grab those for you! I'll be at the community center bright and early with my gear ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, you know me—I'm already rounding up a pile of old gadgets from folks on my block. It's going to be quite a sight this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like you're off to a great start, Tess! I've got a few spare extension cords and a power strip if you need 'em for the repair station.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, that's perfect! I'll add those to the pile—every little bit helps get things running again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think we're good on supplies, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Bo! Just remember we're meeting at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, 9 AM. I'll be there, probably late by five minutes like always.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there Saturday morning, just let me know where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning? I thought it was next Sunday... or was that the potluck? Either way, I'll find it if I remember to bring my map.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's definitely Saturday. Faye mentioned sorting donations at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, see you both at 9. I'll have the screws too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, what screws? Are you helping Cleo with the repair drive now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not for the drive, for the playground bench. Just in case we need them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Rey, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm hoping to get my porch step fixed—do you know if there's still room on the sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think there's still space. I signed up for Saturday—want me to check the sheet with you after lunch?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That'd be wonderful, Rey! I'd sure appreciate the company and the help figuring out the sign-up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Eli, are you talking about the community center's repair drive this Saturday? I want to make sure we're on the same page before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that's the one. Starts at 9 AM, fixing the garden shed and benches—I'll be there at 8 to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Eli—I thought it was at 10 AM. Did the time change? I double-checked the board.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Kira, I understand your hesitation, but I'd rather we catch any small issues now before they turn into big problems.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I get that, but what exactly did those 'odd noises' sound like? I still didn't hear anything when I was there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It was a faint grinding sound, like metal rubbing against metal. I only caught it when I was near the back panel.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, let's head to the café—I've got the list of tools we're still short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can grab my spare wrench set from home if we're running low—just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be fantastic, Cleo! I’ll add your wrenches to the list—we’re definitely going to need all the help we can get.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
